chunk_map.heading: The first slice tests what you are least sure of

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: l6: "Jeff Patton's story map gives that shape" - 'that shape' resolves to the preceding sentence 'Cut across the whole journey ... works end to end'; 'the slice' (l4,l6) resolves to 'the first slice' in the header. No cross-slide referent.
grep for 'lecture|opening|earlier|previous|module' in body (l1-6) -> 0 positional callbacks; closest: l6 'Jeff Patton's story map' names a source by title.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw' backward references in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: l4: 'the first slice tests the assumption you are least sure of' is a self-carrying claim; body is two full paragraphs (99 words).
l1 header 'The first slice tests what you are least sure of' vs l4 opening claim 'the first slice tests the assumption you are least sure of'; l6 extends rather than contradicts it.

Closest: l4 'Not the easiest part, not the part the roadmap lists first.' - a single trailing contrast after a declarative claim, not the 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction (Z precedes, no triple). No anaphora triple, self-grading superlative, number+retraction, abstraction-noun stack or verb triplet. grep -nE 'Not [a-z ]+\. Not ' -> 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -ciE 'surface|firing|compendium|forcing function|beat|mood' on body l1-6 -> 0. Closest: l6 'story map', 'slice' are Patton's practitioner vocabulary, ordinary for the PO/PM audience.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget - bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body l1-6 -> 0 bolded elements; within budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content - verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no layout/wrapper change; slide file has ## and slide-id marker so it is inlined transparently

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering - position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js -> 'OK - 55 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.' exit 0; header carries no hand-number.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js -> 'OK - 55 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.' exit 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links; review aid, never a gate

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size - 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: l1 'The first slice tests what you are least sure of' is a declarative claim, correct for a lecture slide.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies - three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: l6 'Cheap also tempts you to build one part well and leave the rest.' - adds the failure the next sentence cures, not a restatement of l4; no design commentary, no kicker.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Header l1 promises 'first slice tests what you are least sure of'; l4 states exactly that; l6 develops how to cut it. No bullet answers an old header (maintainer l10: header is the squint's retitle, opening line composed as the claim).

notes: Single-chunk slide file. No dated accept-notes in the maintainer block; fidelity guards are source notes, not accept-notes.
